Scored with the mapping pre-registered for v2 on 2026-08-31 and NOT extended to claim SOL-020 to SOL-030, because a mapping written after both the rules and the corpus are known is not a pre-registration. The row understates v3 on purpose. It is a new row, not a correction of v2's 4 / 11: a number that moved because the tool changed is a different fact from one that moved because the corpus changed.
